condo: Normanton Park, 2 bed + Loft, Sea view, move in ready

history.summary: 2BR+Loft sea-view unit (786 sqft) at $1.5M / $1,908 psf in Normanton Park, Kingsford's ~1,862-unit D05 mega-development completed 2023. The PSF sits a touch below recent 2BR resale (~$2,100/psf), but the sheer size of the development means heavy concurrent resale supply that caps near-term appreciation.
history.rating_rationale: D05 RCR location near One-North/West Coast with sea views and a sub-median entry PSF is genuinely attractive, and 2BR is the deepest rental/resale segment. But ~1,862 units create persistent internal resale and rental competition, Kingsford has a mixed build-quality reputation worth diligence, and 99-yr LH from a 2023 TOP means the early appreciation window competes against ongoing developer/subsale stock. Balanced.
